origin.summary: Reorients Open Ink Library from generic book tools to individual source-owned public tools, beginning with Toonverse fetch and search.

events.note: Implementation authorized for the source-first Toonverse slice.
Expanded the source tool contract with complete metadata-plus-chapter-page retrieval.
Restored toonverse.fetch as metadata-only and added toonverse.fetch-full for complete metadata plus the first chapter page.
Added fetch-full chapter page controls and the source-owned fetch-chapter request; response schemas remain deferred.
Added fetch-chapters for validated inclusive reader chapter ranges of up to 10 payloads.
Added the no-network chapter-range-cap validation test; module verification now passes with 19 tests.
Removed the unintended 10-chapter cap; fetch-chapters now supports the caller-supplied inclusive range.
User authorized a Toonverse source operation that downloads chapter pages into the server-owned ToolStorageWorkspace book layout.
Added toonverse.download-book with source page and cover downloads, book/chapter descriptors, and ToolStorageWorkspace publication.
Resolved after module tests and focused server MCP discovery/storage tests passed. Response-interface modeling and generic book tools remain intentionally deferred.
A real 1..300 download-book call returned JSON-RPC -32603. Investigation is active to correct the unhonored operation timeout and provide a bounded, observable download result.
Published function timeout metadata to MCP dispatch, honored configured tool timeouts for tools/call, and added chapter availability preflight before storage is opened.
Resolved after focused tool-framework, source-tool, and server regression tests passed.
